professionalService.problemSolved: Shows an illustrative construction sequence from a site-camera viewpoint while connecting visible build stages to a programme, a changing daylight clock and a final interior walk-through.
professionalService.serviceOutcome: A viewer can see how the same timber house rises over 14 authored weeks, approach it after handover and inspect five interior locations.
professionalService.decisionValue: Useful for communicating spatial consequences and a possible site presentation; the dates, clock, phase progress and CRITICAL PATH are synthetic demo displays, not actual site telemetry or certified work.
